name: PhoenixMiner
description: Containerised version of PhoenixMiner. Helps turn your Unraid server into an Ethereum / cryptocurrency mining rig. Contains AMD drivers. Not affected by the AMD reset bug as it doesn't rely on vfio. Works with most Nvidia GPUs as well via Open Source drivers. Check the support link for detailed installation instructions.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Used for basic monitoring over http/https built into PhoenixMiner

variables.name: Wallet Address
variables.description: Wallet address for receiving mined coin

variables.name: Pool Password
variables.description: Most pools just use 'x' as password, some pools treat this variable as a worker ID

variables.name: Safety: Target Temperature
variables.description: Target temperature for fans (only works if privileged mode is enabled)

variables.name: Safety: Stop Temperature
variables.description: PhoenixMiner will pause mining on a GPU if it hits this temperature (only works if privileged mode is enabled)

variables.name: Safety: Resume Temperature
variables.description: PhoenixMiner will resume mining on a GPU if it hits this temperature after being paused (only works if privileged mode is enabled)

variables.name: AMD Driver Version
variables.description: Leave this variable alone unless you have a reason to change to a different driver version. Options for AMD are '18.20', '20.20', '20.45', '20.50'; '20.20' is recommended for everyone unless you have a 6800XT or 6900XT in which case choose '20.45'. The other options are for testing purposes only. Nvidia cards should work regardless of the option chosen here, but you can enter '0' to remove the default AMD drivers on launch if you really want to.

variables.name: Nvidia Visible Devices
variables.description: Nvidia Only: Enter your GPU UUID here (only required if you plan to mine with an Nvidia GPU otherwise leave this empty. Don't forget to add '--runtime=nvidia' to your 'Extra Parameters' in the Advanced View).

variables.name: Nvidia Driver Capabilities
variables.description: Please leave this set to the default option of 'all' if you aren't sure what to put here. This value can be left in the template even if you don't want to mine with an Nvidia GPU.

devices.name: GPU Device
devices.description: GPU passthrough from host to container. This Isn't necessary if privileged mode is enabled, but won't hurt.
